text.card: A red giant 2,643 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.82 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,602 K at its surface.
